facts.fact: Croissance Afrique reports that Mali's APDP held a board session from 5 February 2024 chaired by its president.
The APDP president is quoted as saying the board's files show the complexity of the missions the law on personal data protection gives the authority.
The APDP president said the session of 5 February 2024 had 147 files before it, including 115 declarations on video surveillance systems and 27 authorisation requests.
